titles.title: I Have Decided to Follow Jesus

verse.name: v1a
v1b
v1c
verse.lines:
Tho' none go with me, still I will follow,
Tho' none go with me, still I will follow,
Tho' none go with me, still I will follow;
No turning back, no turning back.

verse.name: v1d
v1e
verse.lines:
I made my vows, no turning around
I burned my bridges, they can't be found
